title: Hasty Generalization Fallacy — Lesson and Activity
skills: define and recognize the hasty generalization fallacy
identify conclusions based on insufficient or unrepresentative evidence
evaluate whether evidence is adequate to support a broad claim
revise weak generalizations by using stronger, more representative support
alignment_note: Explains the hasty generalization fallacy and provides practice identifying conclusions drawn from insufficient or unrepresentative evidence. Supports logical-fallacy recognition, argument analysis, evidence evaluation, critical thinking, and responsible claim development across high school English courses.
